claim_boundary: This is internal process learning from exact-source renewal and protected regressions. It does not establish linearizable remote truth, external behavioral capability, AGI, or completion.
next: Return to Root and publish the behavioral-outcome primitive, CI and Work observation safe-renewal repairs, tests, and immutable native records through a new isolated latest-main exact-head PR. Then select physically blinded multi-case behavioral evidence.
reason: The renewal defect is implementation and contract work, not a new prompt Candidate. The existing dual-verdict Candidate captures the reusable evaluation lesson, but its deterministic activation gate remains absent.
retained_learning: Immutable observation identity must include a per-attempt boundary such as one requested_at value shared by the identifier seed and request body.
A new renewal must perform a new source read and cross-bind its own request; no prior connector output can be reused.
Verification may select the latest fresh valid same-source receipt while retaining exact source, executor, model, owner, generation, fence, freshness, future-skew, and tamper checks.
Timestamped connector observations remain non-linearizable because the authoritative source can move immediately after the read.
Bounded-unit PASS and user-level FAIL must remain separate through Task Evaluate, Consolidate, Learn, and Root.
Repository tests, CI, source receipts, and native O integration are engineering provenance rather than independent capability evidence.
